cross_host_observation.note: The original 0.20 max-abs gate was calibrated on Ryzen only. Allow 0.25 for the observed runner deviation; retain cosine and exact transcript gates. Engine load verifies the pinned model checksum. The historical run used the previous default loader and persistent optimized cache; it predates the explicit CPU/rnnt settings and fresh-cache probe. The cause of the host/runtime deviation is not established.
